description: Reason-symbol vocabularies for enforcement-evidence fixtures that document historical contract deployments. The current vocabulary is always extracted from src/types.rs; this file only records versions that predate the current package version, so historical evidence is validated against the symbols that deployment actually emitted instead of being rewritten to today's enum.

phase1-testnet.source: Phase 1 testnet guard deployment: WASM upload tx d43edd086ac9b376371f33b72ad89b37a9b6b4d43bf34dfea9717a29688b887c (2026-09-08), recorded in tests/fixtures/index.json. The deployment predates release versioning, so this vocabulary lists the reason symbols its recorded auth_checked events emitted; it does not claim to be the build's complete Error enum.

remediation.description: Per-reason remediation guidance for the three primary observer seats (agent, operator, auditor). Authoritative text lives in docs/reason-glossary.md; this object exposes machine-readable summaries for SDK middleware and tooling. Extend with new reasons when src/types.rs adds a variant — see docs/contributing.md#how-to-add-a-new-error-variant-end-to-end.

unauthorized.agent: Stop; the observable failure is a host abort, not a block reason. Re-derive credentials, verify nonce/expiry, escalate. Never try alternate keys.
unauthorized.operator: Re-register the intended key via rotate_agent_key or re-provision credentials.
unauthorized.auditor: Wrong-key attempts surface as host aborts, not auth_checked events.

already_initialized.agent: Not agent-initiated; treat as an idempotency note if surfaced. Stop automated retries; escalate if unexpected.
already_initialized.operator: None — the account is already initialized. Verify with status() before considering redeployment.
already_initialized.auditor: Documents a double-init attempt (usually benign automation); on-chain state unchanged.

not_initialized.agent: Not agent-initiated; cease operations and notify the operator — the guard is in pre-activation default-deny.
not_initialized.operator: Run initialize with the admin identity and the registered agent public key; verify with status().
not_initialized.auditor: Marks the pre-activation window where all calls were default-denied.

invalid_config.agent: Not agent-initiated; the previous policy is still in effect (fail-closed). Notify the operator.
invalid_config.operator: Correct the config per §8 validation rules and re-apply. Use validate_policy to surface the failing rule before submitting.
invalid_config.auditor: The proposed policy was refused; the on-chain policy is unchanged (fail-closed).

invalid_amount.agent: Fix the caller: zero or negative amounts are a client bug, not a policy limit.
invalid_amount.operator: Check the agent code path is not emitting non-positive amounts; high frequency indicates a noisy client.
invalid_amount.auditor: Attests the account never admits a non-positive transfer.

no_pending_admin.operator: Propose a rotation first (propose_admin_rotation), or verify whether a concurrent operator already confirmed or cancelled.
no_pending_admin.auditor: Records an out-of-order rotation attempt; admin, policy, and revision are unchanged.

admin_frozen.agent: Halt immediately; do not retry. Heartbeat is blocked too — escalate to the operator.
admin_frozen.operator: Establish why the freeze was set, then unfreeze() (also re-arms LastHeartbeat).
admin_frozen.auditor: A hard stop; the later unfrozen event is the admin's recovery attestation.

heartbeat_expired.agent: Cannot self-recover; notify the operator immediately and stop all operations.
heartbeat_expired.operator: Verify agent liveness, then unfreeze() to re-arm LastHeartbeat; consider raising dms_grace_secs.
heartbeat_expired.auditor: Proves the dead-man switch fired for the recorded silence window; reconcile with policy.

no_policy.agent: Cease — default-deny is by design; request a policy from the operator.
no_policy.auditor: At revoke time default-deny held; the later policy_set event is the record.

paused.agent: Suspend activity and poll status() at a reasonable interval until paused clears; do not route around.
paused.operator: Resume via set_policy with paused: false after maintenance completes.
paused.auditor: Operator kill-switch usage; pairs with the re-open event.

outside_active_window.agent: Wait for the activity window; schedule operations inside it.
outside_active_window.operator: Correct the window bounds via set_policy if the timetable changed.
outside_active_window.auditor: Attests spend stays within the declared activity window at T.

asset_not_allowed.agent: Only operate on policy-listed assets; read policy() before choosing.
asset_not_allowed.operator: Add the asset to assets if it is intended (admin-attested change).

recipient_not_allowed.operator: Add the recipient, or consciously enable allow_any_recipient.

per_tx_cap_exceeded.agent: Halt and escalate; do not retry immediately. Never split one payment into multiple smaller ones to dodge the cap — that is evasion.
per_tx_cap_exceeded.operator: Raise per_tx_cap if the business need genuinely grew, or restate the limit.
per_tx_cap_exceeded.auditor: Per-tx bound held at T (event and tx reference).

window_cap_exceeded.agent: Wait for window entries to expire (window_secs) before retrying; escalate. Do not re-route spend outside the accounting path to evade the window.
window_cap_exceeded.operator: Raise window_cap if legitimately needed, or reset cadence expectations.
window_cap_exceeded.auditor: Rolling cap held over the [T − window_secs, T] span (invariant, §3.1).

protocol_not_allowed.operator: Add the protocol to the allowlist if intended.

function_not_allowed.operator: Extend the per-protocol fns list if intended.

asset_fn_not_allowed.agent: Use only the SAC transfer functions supported by the policy; do not attempt other asset operations.
asset_fn_not_allowed.operator: Use an admin-approved path if the asset operation is intended; the guard does not authorize SAC minting or burning.
asset_fn_not_allowed.auditor: Records that a non-transfer function on a listed asset was denied.

unknown_contract.agent: Unknown contracts are default-deny in v1; consult policy() and do not attempt workarounds.
unknown_contract.operator: Allowlist the contract if it should be callable under v1 intent.

self_function_not_allowed.agent: The agent may only call its own heartbeat; management functions belong to the admin seat.
self_function_not_allowed.operator: Use the admin path for management; align tooling, no contract change needed.
self_function_not_allowed.auditor: Records the self-call surface being contained to the heartbeat/check path.

create_contract_not_allowed.agent: The account never authorizes contract creation in v1 — route creation to a dedicated operator-owned account.
create_contract_not_allowed.operator: Create contracts from a non-guarded account.
create_contract_not_allowed.auditor: Proves the account never authorizes creation.

recipient_blocked.agent: Do not retry or attempt to disguise the destination; stop and escalate.
recipient_blocked.operator: Remove the denylist entry only if policy intent changed.
recipient_blocked.auditor: The explicit recipient denylist blocked this destination.

protocol_call_rate_exceeded.agent: Wait for calls in the rolling window to expire; do not route around the configured protocol limit or dispatch via a different entry to evade the count.
protocol_call_rate_exceeded.operator: Raise protocol_calls_per_window via set_policy if the limit is legitimately too low; investigate whether the agent is making more calls than intended.
protocol_call_rate_exceeded.auditor: Records that the configured per-protocol rolling call limit was reached at T.

decision_invariant_violation.agent: Stop and escalate; do not retry or attempt workarounds. The enforcement engine detected an impossible state.
decision_invariant_violation.operator: Report contract version, transaction hash, and full diagnostic event log to maintainers. Pause the policy (set_policy with paused: true) until root cause is understood.
decision_invariant_violation.auditor: Signals an enforcement implementation invariant failure. Preserve full transaction diagnostics and the auth_checked event log.

too_many_auth_contexts.agent: Do not split or reroute the batch to evade the bound; reduce the intended authorization only if its policy meaning is unchanged, otherwise escalate.
too_many_auth_contexts.operator: Review the router batch size and transaction design; the contract limit is fixed, not policy-configurable.
too_many_auth_contexts.auditor: The engine rejected the whole authorization before parsing contexts or staging window admissions.
